'''Dacha-syrup''' was a type of [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] described as having an oozing quality. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] initiate, [[Novar (Human)|Novar]], had compared the thick accent of the [[Sith King]]<ref name="TOTJC" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>&mdash;[[Adas]]'&mdash;voice to the oozing syrup. This occurred following his summoning of<ref name="TOTJC" /> the [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith's]]<ref name="END" /> visage via [[Holocron of King Adas|Adas' holocron]] housed deep within the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon's]] undercity<ref name="TOTJC" /> sometime no earlier than [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="ECDate">The events of the short story detailing [[Novar (Human)|Novar]] and [[Adas]]' interaction takes place prior to the events of [[Tales of the Jedi 1|''Tales of the Jedi'' 1]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states takes place in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dacha-syrup was mentioned in the [[1996]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', written by [[George R. Strayton]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="TOTJC" />
